prompts.prompt-r1.txt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create one original high-detail 16:9 landscape scene, documentary tourist eye-level photographic realism, an AI artistic interpretation of City of Arts and Sciences, Valencia. One real Hemisfèric only: shallow elliptical ribbed glazed shell like an opening eye, central white hemispherical IMAX dome sits inside, straight low waterline beneath; matching pool reflection below. No generic spaceship, no extra dome on roof, no duplicated arches. Show the entire building distant and centered within central 40% of landscape width so a centered portrait crop retains its entire shell and reflection. Pool covers lower half; just a strip of walkway at bottom and lateral context. Not a drone. Eye-level public northeast basin edge looking southwest, slightly oblique but near frontal. Restrained cool-white and faint cyan architectural lighting, supported by historical night photography; no purple event display.
Scenario: 23 September 2026 · 21:52 Europe/Madrid; full NIGHT, sun elevation -22.44 degrees, azimuth 290.07 degrees below horizon; no sunlight, no dusk orange horizon. Fresh Open-Meteo model: 24.2C, cloud cover 55%, precipitation 0mm, wind 2km/h; model data not an on-site observation. Sky near-black with subdued broken cloud texture, no moon or visible stars. Artificial lighting modest with realistic shadow falloff; preserve stone/glass detail without fake HDR. No rain, fog, reflections on dry pavement, obvious people, contemporary artwork focal subject, logos, promotional lettering, or fantasy details. Make a coherent real place with straight architectural verticals, plausible spatial scale and non-repeated surface texture. Leave bottom 15% visually quiet for later captions. IMPORTANT: NO TEXT, no signature, no watermark in this source; exact labels will be typeset on the exported masters later. Wide environmental composition with main subject fully in the central portrait-safe crop as described, do not enlarge subject to fill entire landscape width. Photographic tonal range, no cinematic golden hour.
